decision: adopt acoustic-supported boundary reconciliation for default monophonic transcription

method.grouping: Merge only frame-contiguous notes whose original median-pitch range across the entire group stays within the existing segmentation threshold. Preserve boundaries with acoustic onset evidence within 50 ms. RMS reattack splitting follows; unavailable evidence preserves boundaries.

cue.method: independent implementation of SuperFlux-style spectral-flux onset evidence
cue.fft_size: Nearest even integer to 2048 * sample_rate / 44100, minimum 2
cue.window: symmetric Hann; zero-padded centered frames, frame start truncated toward zero
cue.fft_bins: Unnormalized magnitude; exclude Nyquist; scale by 2048 / N
cue.filterbank: 24 bands per octave anchored at 440 Hz, extended below 30 Hz and above min(17000 Hz, Nyquist); nearest ties-to-even bins, deduplicated; unit-height triangles; log10(1 + magnitude)
cue.difference: positive differences from maximum of same/adjacent bands two frames earlier
cue.peak: inclusive local max[-2,+10] and value>=mean[-30,0]+1.1; missing average values zero; no debounce

references.title: Böck and Widmer, Maximum Filter Vibrato Suppression for Onset Detection (DAFx2013)

frozen_protocol.acceptance: All existing controls and exact native onset oracle pass. On observed Vocadito 40 and the fixed-gain development 28, both annotators note/offset micro-F must be nondecreasing. On separate VocalSet 18, extended1 primary and extended4 sensitivity note/offset micro-F must be nondecreasing. No post-result parameter changes.

scoring.transforms: Original native 44100 Hz audio; no resampling, normalization, cropping, or alignment fitting. Gain-only control is explicitly separate.

vocadito.status: All 40 recordings observed before this candidate; regression evidence, not a fresh holdout.

vocalset.selection: Exclude f1 used only for format inspection. Retain singers with all three fixed styles on vowel a. Sort singer IDs by SHA256 of libsonare-vocalset-confirm-v1: followed by the ID, then take the first six; choose all three styles for each.
vocalset.reference_pitch: Median F0 of human-reviewed Sound intervals; pitch contours assisted by pYIN; not independently manual frame-F0 labels
vocalset.primary: extended1 with explicit transition intervals; Sound rows only
vocalset.sensitivity: extended4 splitting transitions at midpoint; Sound rows only
vocalset.annotation_conversion: Start time, End time, Median F0; preserve source seconds/Hz
vocalset.verification: HTTPS byte-range retrieval from versioned records; individual ZIP member CRC32/size checked and SHA256 recorded; whole archive MD5 not verified
vocalset.speaker_overlap: different corpora; speaker-disjointness across anonymized corpora is not established
vocalset.status_after_evaluation: All 18 selected recordings are now observed and cannot serve as untouched future confirmation.

gain_control.input: Int16 / 32768 to float32, multiply by 0.1, write float32 WAV; unchanged annotation; no normalization or re-quantization.

validation.independent_source_review: passed after terminal bounds repair and header qualification

limits: Primary VocalSet note-F improvement is only 0.000119, with two fewer true positives; absolute primary scores remain low.
Pooled F improvements do not imply every recording or recall improved; complete counts and recording outcomes are included.
The absolute spectral novelty threshold is gain-sensitive. The fixed minus 20 dB control passed but does not prove gain invariance; its A1/A2 note true positives fell by 16/10.
Known 110 Hz short repeated notes remain missed; the incorrect one-note output is not a passing accuracy assertion.
One development annotated onset lies 59.6 ms from the pitch boundary and falls outside the fixed 50 ms acoustic support interval.
Six singers and 18 recordings do not establish broad instrument or recorded-music accuracy; no statistical significance claim is made.
No public pYIN algorithm, shared editing provider, persisted vocal analysis format, or public API changed in this candidate.

performance.schedule: baseline,candidate alternating serial, three each; original observed development28; unchanged defaults; one full export per run; this machine also had unrelated background work
performance.interpretation: Three alternating serial runs per executable. Median user CPU increased about 7.2%; wall time and RSS varied with unrelated background work. These are local measurements, not a performance guarantee.

synthetic_reattack_matrix.interpretation: No measurable overhead in this short matrix; it does not characterize full recordings.
